why: B is false (not_B, rt_check OK), as its author predicted. B uses the literal p. 228 formula, psi(beta(s)) on [1/2,1]. Take beta0(s) = kappa(3s) + kappa(3s-2), which satisfies all of B's conditions. In X = R^1, phi = the constant path at 0 and psi = id, a path from 0 to 1, have no composite: at s = 1/2 the two formulas give phi(beta0(1/2)) = 0 and psi(beta0(1/2)) = psi(1) = 1. So A => B is false (A holds) and B => A holds only ex falso; 'A_narrower' is the formal label. The comparison that carries content is with BIntended (the formula psi(beta(s)-1), with beta(0)=0 and beta(1)=2); see 'intended'.
intended: A_stronger: A_to_BIntended is proved; BIntended_to_A is not. The proof of A_to_BIntended uses A's const-path smoothness, ScHomotopic.refl/symm/trans, ScPath.concat_congr, const_concat, concat_const and concat_assoc, plus glue proved without the item's theorems: betaConcat (a composite exists for every admissible beta: a two-piece map glued by a local copy of the gluing lemma) and scHomotopic_concatPath_of_beta (every beta-composite is homotopic rel end points to the project's concatPath, by a straight-line homotopy of the inner reparametrizations; both pieces equal the junction point near s = 1/2). So the project's single concatenation, kappa(3s) / kappa(3s-2), represents the text's class [psi]*[phi] for every admissible beta. BIntended => A fails: A also states the groupoid laws (concat_reverse, reverse_concat, PathCat.inv_mk), the smoothness of end points, ScHomotopic.symm for arbitrary maps, the presentation of PathCat (comp_mk, id_eq_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff, exists_eq_mk) and technical tools (isScSmoothMap_ite/ite3, isScHomotopyRel_triHomotopy, smoothTransition_half, the concatPath formulas). BIntended's laws (iii)-(v) give only concat_congr, const_concat, concat_const and concat_assoc (with beta = beta0, for which concatPath phi psi is a beta0-composite). The rest is true but not a consequence of B.
B_issue: B formalizes the misprint literally (psi(beta(s)) on [1/2,1] with beta([1/2,1]) = [1,2]); its author flagged it and supplied BIntended with the evident correction psi(beta(s)-1).
overlap: B_to_A (ex falso) and A_to_BIntended: 323 shared project theorems each, all reached through the statement A (sc-calculus, chart and retract glue under ScPath, PathCat and the path lemmas); no lemma of the formal proof is reused beyond A's own conjuncts (taken from the hypothesis in A_to_BIntended). Checks: not_B passes #rt_check. B_to_A and A_to_BIntended cannot pass #rt_check or #rt_check_soft, because their statements contain A, and A's PathCat.category composes by ScPathClass.comp = Quotient.map2 ScPath.concat ScPath.concat_congr: the banned concat_congr (proved with the banned isScSmoothMap_ite) is passed directly, not as a _proof_N; this failure is recorded with #guard_msgs. They pass #rt_check_except_defs (as in V1_32, V3_64, V6_19) with the bodies of A's vocabulary definitions ScPathClass.comp, ScPathClass.reverse, PathCat.category, PathCat.groupoid, ScPath.const and ScPath.setoid not unfolded.
